finding.claim: kmctl plugin status --harness antigravity reports a version mismatch with the fix 'run kmctl plugin update', which defaults to --harness claude: following it in an Antigravity-only repository installs Claude Code's skills, settings.json hook and .mcp.json, and leaves .agents/ and .agents/plugins/kmctl/ at the old version. The fix must name the harnesses status was asked about.

fixes.change: status's version-mismatch problem now names `kmctl plugin update --harness <the harnesses checked>` (plus --scope user), so an Antigravity-only repository is not pointed at a claude install.
test_status_version_mismatch_names_the_harness edits the lock ref and asserts the problem ends with `run kmctl plugin update --harness antigravity`.
test_status_mismatched_ref_names_update now expects `--harness claude` in the fix.
The plugin status section says an older package names `kmctl plugin update --harness HARNESS`.
